Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then Moses went up from the wilderness of Moab to Mount Nebo, the summit of the fortress, which is opposite Jericho; and God showed him all of Jericho, and God showed him all the land, from Jerash to Banias.
translations.2: And all the land of Naphtali, and Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea.
translations.3: And the south and the meadows — the valley of Jericho, the town of palms — as far as Zoar.
translations.4: And He said to him: 'This is the land which I swore to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, saying: To your offspring I shall give it. I have shown it to you with your own eyes — but you shall not cross over to there.'
translations.5: And Moses, the messenger of God, died in the land of Moab, according to the word of God.
translations.6: And He buried him in the valley, in the land of Moab, in the vicinity of Beth-Peor; and no one has known the place of his grave to this day.
translations.7: And Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died; his eye had not grown dim, nor had his moisture departed.
translations.8: And the sons of Israel wept for Moses in the wilderness of Moab thirty days, until the days of mourning for him were completed.
translations.9: And Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, since Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the sons of Israel accepted from him and acted accordingly, as God had commanded Moses.
translations.10: And there arose no prophet again in Israel like Moses — for God had spoken with him directly, mouth to mouth.
translations.11: And for all the signs and the proofs which God sent him to perform in the land of Egypt — against Pharaoh and against all his officers and against the rest of the people of his land —
translations.12: and for all the mighty hand, and for all the great terrors, which Moses wrought in the presence of all the house of Israel.
